verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a SaaS incorporation service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no first-party natural-language command interface, assistant, or agent for operating Atlas. The llms.txt file and markdown docs probes show only LLM-readable documentation, an adjacent building block that earns no credit for actually operating the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
